|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-67-Luke_Skywalker_Strong_In_The_Force-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 6 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force]].
* '''Original''' ([[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Red 5 or Rogue 1 (or armed with Luke's Lightsaber), may add one destiny to total power or attrition, and I Have You Now is canceled. When leaving table, place all your cards on Luke in Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 4.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “When leaving table, place all your cards on Luke” to “When Luke leaves table, place all your cards on him”: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Red 5 or Rogue 1 (or armed with Luke's Lightsaber), may add one destiny to total power or attrition, and I Have You Now is canceled. When Luke leaves table, place all your cards on him in Used Pile. Immune to attrition < 4.”.<ref name="cl-1261_71-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
